page: Microsoft Azure E4ads_v5 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance configured with 4 vCPUs across 2 physical cores, running on dedicated AMD EPYC 7763 processors clocked up to 3.7 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via Microsoft Hyper-V, the instance includes 32 KB L1 data cache, 1 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache. It incorporates hardware features such as AVX vector extensions, AES-NI, and SHA-NI cryptographic instructions, while omitting AVX-512 and AMX extensions. System memory totals 32.0 GB, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU allocation of 8.0 GB per thread.

Storage provisions include 161 GB of local SSD capacity, providing fast scratch space, and the instance supports Azure Premium Storage. The configuration contains no dedicated GPUs and does not bundle complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Synthetic testing highlights a sharp divergence between single-thread and parallel throughput. In stress-ng single-core tests, the CPU achieves strong results in the top 25%, with solid single-core Geekbench performance (1493.0) and single-threaded gzip compression at 26.03 GB/sec. However, due to its low physical core count, parallel processing scores fall into the lower quartile, as evidenced by multi-core stress-ng (5395.86), PassMark CPU (6153.74), and Geekbench multi-core (3363.0) metrics.

Memory subsystem testing shows 37.42 GB/sec uncached read bandwidth and 22.82 GB/sec write bandwidth, alongside average PassMark memory scores (2299.11). Throughput for operational workloads reflects the constraint of having only four execution threads, registering 4.15 million operations per second on Redis SET tasks and 5.05 GB/sec on static web serving. Generative AI tasks are constrained by the absence of discrete accelerators, with 7B LLM generation recording 4.73 tokens per second.

Given its high RAM-to-CPU ratio and included local SSD, the E4ads_v5 offers favorable resource efficiency for small-to-midsize relational databases, in-memory caching tiers, and memory-intensive ETL tasks that do not require wide core parallelization.
description: Microsoft Azure E4ads_v5 is a memory-optimized virtual machine powered by dedicated AMD EPYC 7763 processors with a clock speed up to 3.7 GHz. The instance delivers 4 vCPUs across 2 physical cores on x86_64 architecture, paired with 32.0 GB of RAM (8.0 GB per vCPU) and a 161 GB local SSD disk. It lacks dedicated GPU accelerators. Benchmark results indicate strong single-core CPU execution, ranking in the top 25% on stress-ng tests, though aggregate multi-core and memory bandwidth metrics reflect its 4-thread envelope. Redis SET operations reach 4.15 million operations per second, while static web serving delivers 5.05 GB/sec. With its high memory-to-core density and bundled local high-speed disk, the E4ads_v5 provides a balanced hardware profile for memory-intensive enterprise workloads, including caching layers, intermediate data transformations, and transactional database instances.
